_comment: Template for a Next.js app. The settings are NOT here: they live in @madfam/tsconfig, so a change to the shared baseline reaches every repo instead of stopping at the copy someone took. Run `pnpm add -D @madfam/tsconfig`, copy this file to your repo as tsconfig.json, and add your own compilerOptions (outDir, rootDir, baseUrl, paths) and include/exclude - TypeScript resolves relative paths against the file they are written in, so those four cannot come from the shared config.
